Machine Learning: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too closely and generalizes poorly.
Precision measures how many predicted positives are actually positive.
Recall measures how many actual positives are correctly identified.
LLMs: Transformers use attention mechanisms to model relationships between tokens.
Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained model to a more specific task or domain.
AI Agents: Agents combine model reasoning with state, tools and actions.
Tool calling allows an agent to interact with external systems.
